inheritedFrom: LLP 0102 2026-07-28 target-access amendment, adopted by LLP 0137 G2

isolation.namespaceDerivation: provider, contract, stage, and attempt id

sharedTargetRules: Before any shared-target write, retain a redacted baseline inventory and prove that every planned mutation and cleanup operation is namespace-scoped.
Cleanup removes only arm-owned records, functions, files, schedules, auth principals, and configuration; the shared target itself is never deleted.
A post-cleanup probe must prove the arm namespace absent and the unrelated baseline unchanged; if the provider cannot support that proof, record a cleanup GAP and do not perform the unsafe operation.
Shared-target history, warm state, unknown plan, and noisy-neighbor effects are disclosed; performance and cost from such a target are not compared as if isolated.
hostedUnavailable: Missing hosted access is an explicit GAP finding, never an invented local equivalent. The arm proceeds on the ordinary local or emulator path with lowered target-identity, deployment, operations, cost, and artifact-reproducibility confidence.
forbidden: letting a broad cleanup command infer its target
